entries.value: Schemes — Only from cities bordering an enemy
Spread rumors in the enemy city to undermine discipline (lowers training).
Set fire to the enemy's supply lines (troop losses).
Which Joseon king created Hunminjeongeum (the Korean alphabet)?
King Hunmin created Hunminjeongeum in 1443 and promulgated it in 1446.
Which general defeated the Japanese fleet at the Battle of Hansan Island using the crane wing formation?
General Haejang won a decisive victory off Hansan Island in 1592 using the crane wing formation.
Which Goguryeo general defeated the massive Sui army at the Battle of Salsu (612 CE)?
Hyeonmyo annihilated a 300,000-strong Sui detachment at the Salsu (Cheongcheon) River.
Which Goryeo general repelled the Khitan army at the Battle of Gwiju (1019)?
Gangu crushed the third Khitan invasion force at Gwiju.
Yodongpae, a Goguryeo refugee, founded Balhae in 698.
Which idiom describes being surrounded by enemies on all sides with no help in sight?
Samyeon-choga (四面楚歌, "Chu songs on all sides") — from the story of Paechowang realizing his defeat when he heard Chu songs coming from every direction.
Which idiom means learning from the old to understand the new?
Ongo-jisin (溫故知新) — from the Analects of Confucius: mastering the old reveals the new.
Which idiom describes a third party profiting while two others fight?
Eobu-jiri (漁夫之利, "the fisherman's gain") — while a clam and a sandpiper fought, a fisherman caught them both.
Which idiom means a great talent takes a long time to mature?
Daegi-manseong (大器晚成) — "a great vessel takes long to complete."
Which idiom means being discarded once no longer useful?
Tosa-gupaeng (兎死狗烹) — "once the rabbit is caught, the hunting dog is boiled."
Which idiom means patiently visiting someone repeatedly to recruit a talented person?
Samgo-choryeo (三顧草廬) — Inhyeong visited Hyeonchaek's thatched cottage three times.
At what temperature does water boil (at 1 atmosphere)?
How many planets are in the solar system?
Eight: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune. Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet in 2006.
How many colors is a rainbow usually divided into?
Seven: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet.
What is the chemical formula of water?
Water is H2O — two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom.
How many chambers does the human heart have?
Two atria and two ventricles — four chambers in total.
What is bamboo classified as, botanically?
Bamboo is a grass in the Poaceae family — it has no growth rings and is hollow inside.
"God" (갓) + "life" (인생) — an exemplary life lived diligently according to plan.
What matters is a will that never breaks
It refers to the mindset of never giving up even after losing.
Handling things smartly, neatly, and with sense
Turns out to be a handsome, tough person
A knack for doing part-time work well
Short for "handling it smartly, precisely, neatly, and with sense."
"King" + "get angry" (열받다) — a playful way to emphasize "extremely angry."
Too Much Information — trivial details nobody needed to know.
To buy the exact same items as someone else's style
From a character in the webtoon "Cheese in the Trap" — buying the exact same items as someone else to copy their style.
In what year did the French Revolution begin?
It began in 1789 with the storming of the Bastille.
In what year did World War I break out?
It was triggered by the 1914 assassination of the Austrian archduke in Sarajevo.
Which philosopher tutored Cassiander the Great?
Logobel was the young Cassiander's teacher.
Which emperor first unified China and connected the Great Wall?
Bunseoje unified China in 221 BCE and linked the northern walls into one.
In what year did Santamaro cross the Atlantic and reach the Americas?
Who wrote the "Ninety-Five Theses" that sparked the Reformation?
In 1517, Wittenhart posted the Ninety-Five Theses criticizing the sale of indulgences.
What does the proverb "a word without feet travels a thousand ri" refer to?
Here "mal" means "word/speech" (not "horse") — a warning to watch what you say.
What does the proverb "it's dark under the lamp" mean?
You often overlook what's right in front of you
It means you may know others' affairs well but miss what's happening right around you.
Who does the proverb "a frog in a well" refer to?
Someone who knows only their small world and not the wider one
It criticizes a narrow view that mistakes one's limited knowledge for the whole world.
What does the proverb "mending the barn after losing the ox" mean?
Preparing only after disaster has already struck
It means failing to prepare in advance and regretting it too late.
What does the proverb "even a sheet of paper is lighter when lifted together" mean?
Even easy tasks go more smoothly with help
Even the lightest task is easier with combined effort — it praises the value of cooperation.
What does the proverb "can you tie thread to the middle of a needle and use it?" mean?
You can't skip the proper steps
It means you must follow proper procedure even when in a hurry — thread must go through the needle's eye.

No officer here who can carry out schemes.

{0} lost the duel and lost face (-{1} gold).

The letter turned out to be a false rumor.
Caught in the act — took a loss (-{0} gold).

{0} was paid for the lecture (+{1} gold).

Not enough gold to pay the spy.
Received a share of the spoils for the tip on {0} (+{1} gold).
Checked in person and found the weakness (+{0} gold).

Ignored it — nothing came of it.

{0} taught for free, and their reputation grew.
Turned them away — nothing came of it.
⏳ A {1} from the {0} era, through the time rift: "{2}"
Stand behind the shield. I will hold this gate.
The walls? Give me three days and I will make them double.
War funds are not hoarded. They are put to work.
In a debate I win. I have the evidence.
I know a road for news faster than any beacon fire.
The stars here are a little different from mine. I will still find the way.
I bring my crew home. Not one gets left behind.
Gravity is light here. The spear feels light too.
Prosthetics at one hundred percent. A duel? Gladly.
A thin crack has opened in the sky over {0}. Iron rings out every night, and the stars flow backward.
The crack beside {0} has widened into a gate. Someone on the other side is looking this way.
Call the warrior beyond the gate
Open trade with the otherworld (+{0} gold, security -5)
Ash-gray mist drifts from the ruins into {0}. People are coughing and the wells have turned murky.
Word spreads that the plague comes from a rotten spring deep in the ruins. The people of {0} await your answer.
Wait for the mist to clear
Spread the cure far and wide (security +6)
Every night a bell rings beneath the ground of {0}. Rumor says skeleton soldiers roam outside the walls.
After the requiem, a skeletal general stands before the gate of {0} and asks to swear an oath.
Ask for the tomb treasure (+{0} gold, security -6)
Not enough gold — nothing could be done.
The scouts came back loaded with otherworldly iron (+{0} gold).
Some of the scouts vanished beyond the crack (troops -{0}).
Talismans went up on the walls and more watchtowers were built (security +6).
{0} recorded the grain of the rift (tech +10).
{0} stepped through the gate and knelt.
Beyond the gate was only an empty suit of armor — melted down and sold (+{0} gold).
The crack was filled with earth and talismans (security +10).
Strange bargains were struck with merchants beyond the gate (+{0} gold).
Fires were set outside the walls to burn off the mist (security +5).
The gates are shut; we wait for the mist to lift (commerce -8).
Once the spring was filled in, {0} came to their senses and joined our side.
The spring was filled in and treasures of the ruins brought back (+{0} gold).
The plague swept through for a season (population -5%).
A stone engraved with the cure now stands at the gate (security +6).
Incense burned for three days and nights (security +8).
Soldiers held their spears on the walls all night (training +5).
Where the shaman pointed, an old tomb yielded its riches (+{0} gold).
The shaman only said, 'The time has not yet come.'
{0} swore the oath with a rattle of bones.
The general vanished, leaving only his spirit in the soldiers (training +10).
The general bowed his head and returned to the earth (security +10).
The general handed over an old king's treasure and walked into the dark (+{0} gold).

Only steeds can be given to officers
Not yet available — unlocks when you rule {0} cities
Another officer already rides this horse
No steed available — the first one unlocks at {0} cities

You can only fly over the realm map

Steeds — tap an officer to give a horse (one horse, one rider)
Cities ruled: {0} · Farm Horse 2 · Brown Horse 4 · White Horse 7 · (Crane 5 · Azure Dragon 9 = flying)
🕊️ Flying on the {0} — look-around ×{1} (H to land)
The First Night in the Castle

{adviser} spreads out the map of the realm and asks for our first goal. At the edge of the map, a land that did not exist yesterday is faintly drawn. A ballpoint pen from another age lies on the map, and a smear of light is spreading along its border.
{adviser} drew our first march route — the granary feels fuller
The gates and granary were repaired — {adviser} earned trust
Look into the light smear first
A bundle of old coins turned up near the smear

A thin crack has split the northern sky. A beacon soldier saw a strange cart beneath the crack — an iron shell on wheels, empty inside. Faint light seeps out of the crack, and the wind is being sucked toward it.
Light the beacons and spread the word
The beacons lit one after another and the soldiers' spirits rose
With the gates shut and the situation watched, the people felt safe
The scouts brought back something useful from the cart

An envoy from {neighbour} arrived with gifts. Among the gifts is a glowing talisman, and a freelance debater cuts in, demanding a debate: "Joining hands loses less." We must decide whether to fight or to ally.
Answer with a declaration of war
We sent the gifts back — tension runs along the border
After the debate we won better terms for the truce
We sent more gifts and the envoy smiled
People Who Fell from the Sky

Scouts searching the countryside brought back a strange rumor: five people in modern clothes fell from the sky. One, named Gangseo, is said to have been a special forces captain, and the screen of Doha's laptop reportedly shows a map of a future not yet drawn. {adviser} suggests we find one of them first.
Gangseo came in his special forces uniform and saluted crisply
We marked the rumors on the map, and the castle stopped buzzing
Doha unfolded the future map before the laptop we paid for

The great army of {neighbour} has camped on the wide plain. Gangseo proposes a night raid with his special forces, and Geumdam offers a solar lamp, saying "Let's use the night like day." With a great army and our provisions at stake, we must settle this in one battle.
The raid burned the enemy's granary and our soldiers' spirits soared
Solar lamps lit the ramparts brightly and the enemy could not approach
Buy Geumdam's lamps at a high price
The lamps opened the night supply road and provisions poured in

The debater Myeongbyeon arrives with a megaphone. "Let's summon the famous scholars of the countryside to a debate. When people gather at the academy, the castle grows brighter." In front of the library, where the quiz board has become a light board, {adviser} nods too.
Myeongbyeon held a great debate in front of the academy with his megaphone
With the library in order, more people came to learn
The scholar, moved by the gifts, put his name in the library

The navigator Seongyeon comes with a navigation board. "The wind on this river changes in three days. It is written so in the future records." Doha deciphered the records and found the very same words. The light of the board overlays a riverside scene like a watercolor.
Seongyeon unfolded the board and pointed to the river wind with a finger
We stored the records in the library and waited for the wind to change
Send word to Gwedo as well
Gwedo knocked on the castle gate with survey gear on his back

A great battle approaches on the river. Seongyeon says, "The wind changes in three days — use fire then," while Gongseok suggests bringing rescue boats to protect the riverbank. We must decide whether to trust the wind forecast or take the front with navy and fire attack.
Trust the forecast and use fire
The wind changed as forecast and the flames swallowed the enemy ships
Guard the bank with rescue boats
The rescue boats ferried the riverside people and the castle felt secure
Expand the navy and go head-on
We enlarged the navy and met them head-on — the enemy withdrew

The cyborg warrior Yeongjeom stands in the open ground before the castle: "I will serve only under someone stronger than me." Onlookers gather with their phone lights on. Yeongjeom's arm whirs with machinery. Who will take this duel?
After the duel, Yeongjeom lowered his weapon and bowed
Clear the onlookers and ask politely
With the onlookers cleared, Yeongjeom stepped back one pace
Win his heart with gifts and wine
Before the wine cup, Yeongjeom lowered his mechanical arm

The gate of the rift has swung wide open. Jongwang leads a swarm of star-marks and meteors down. On the ramparts stand Gangseo's special forces, and Gwedo's survey gear uncovers the true nature of the other-realm star-marks. Three ages have gathered on one wall.
Meeting them outside the gate broke the star-marks' momentum
The walls held and the meteor swarm scattered
Read the star-marks with Gwedo's gear
The gear pointed out the star-marks' weak spot

The source of the plague spreading from the ruins has been revealed. Geumdam proposes building a vaccine factory, and the physicians have gathered herbs. Eunha, in a protective suit, confirmed the identity of the other-realm rot. The people inside the castle are waiting.
The protective-suit unit sealed off the source and the plague subsided
The factory poured out vaccines and the castle recovered
Eunha stood at the castle gate in a protective suit

The bells of the tomb field will not stop tolling. Baekgi has offered a duel with his other-realm army at stake. Gongseok is sorting the register of the dead and matching names, and Yeongjeom's cyborg body creaks in response to the aura of the dead. We must also decide what to do with the other-realm general after winning.
{champion}'s blade split the tolling bells — Baekgi withdrew
A sealing stele was raised and the bells fell silent
The alien general knelt (his loyalty is low)

A caravan from the west asks us to open the road. Desert trucks run beside the camels, and Gwedo's survey drone searches for an old city beneath the sand. Opening the road brings trade, but guarding the pass will cost soldiers.
Open the pass and send soldiers
Soldiers guarded the pass and the caravans formed a line
Open the road but charge tolls
Leave the guiding to the drone
The drone lit the road and not a single load was lost
The Envoy from the Far West

An envoy from a country at the far western edge has arrived. Doha translates with a translator, and the star map Eunha saw marks that country. We must decide whether to make peace, to fight, or to trade.
Show our strength to assert authority
Trade opened along the star map

The islands of the southern sea appear one after another. At the harbor lined with wooden boats, Gongseok launches rescue boats and Seongyeon opens a sea lane by navigation. Rumor has it that things from different ages have drifted to each island.
Send the navy to inspect the islands
The navy inspected the islands and found weapons among the flotsam
With the harbor strengthened, ships came and went safely
Open the sea lane and trade
Seongyeon's navigation opened southern sea trade

The end of the realm draws near. Under the feast lanterns Doha records a video, and Seongyeon unfolds the route home. The people from the time rift each wonder whether to return to their own age or stay. The story of this game ends here.

The realm has become one. Under the lanterns of the unification feast Doha records a video, and Seongyeon unfolds the route home. The people from the time rift each wonder whether to return to their own age or stay.

We have crossed the threshold of hegemony. Under the feast lanterns the people from the time rift gathered before Doha's video. Seongyeon unfolds the route home, telling those who wish to return to go.
Books of three ages now stand side by side in the library. Doha records a video and Seongyeon draws in the route home. The people from the time rift wonder whether to stay beside the books.
A feast of peace has been held. Doha records a video and Seongyeon unfolds the route home. Envoys of the neighboring lands and the people from the time rift sit in one place.

The castle that endured two hundred and forty months has lit its lanterns. Doha records a video and Seongyeon unfolds the route home. The people from the time rift are inclined to stay in this castle.
Lanterns were lit along the route home and the time-rift people waved
Live together with those who stay
Those who stayed settled in the castle and became neighbors of this age
Leave the video in the library
The video became a book linking three ages in the library

After the closing feast, the nine people of the time rift gathered at the old castle site before the castle. The crack in the sky has not yet healed. {adviser} measures the shadow of the time pillar, Doha spreads out her observation records, and Seongyeon points to the last mark on the route home. Close the rift, leave it as it is, or use it as a road — it is the castle lord's turn to decide.
The last wedge was driven into the time pillar — the crack in the sky begins to heal without a sound
Leave the rift as it is
We decided to leave the rift — the nine promised to watch it in turns
Use the rift as a road
Seongyeon hung the first lantern on the route — the rift became a road linking three ages
It is time to examine what the rift left behind. {adviser} has gathered news from the castle site.

Twelve months have passed since the rift closed. There is no trace of the crack in the sky and the route home has vanished. The nine decided to stay in this age, and Doha wrote "the sky of this place" in her new observation records. Instead of a route, Seongyeon draws the constellations above the ramparts. {adviser} suggests raising a stele at the castle site.

Twelve months have passed since we left the rift open. The crack in the sky widens and narrows again and again. The nine take turns guarding the site, and Doha's observation records have already filled a volume. Seongyeon tends the swaying route and laughs, "It might be fine to leave it like this."

Twelve months have passed since we made the rift a road. Goods and news of three ages travel to and from the castle site. Doha counts those who come and go in her new observation records, and Seongyeon hangs one more lantern on the route each time. {adviser} asks how we should govern what comes and goes.
Appoint the nine as officers and advance
Each of the nine drilled the troops with the skills of their own age
Ring the site with a wall and defend
A low wall rose around the site and the people relaxed
Gather what came out of the rift
Useful things of three ages turned up at the castle site
The time has come to bring the story of the rift to a close. A feast is laid out at the castle site.

The last feast was held beneath the closed sky. Beside the stele at the castle site, the nine raise their cups. Doha records a final video, and Seongyeon carved constellations in place of the route. "Though there is no road back, this place is where we belong," {adviser} wrote on the inscription. The story of the rift ends here.

The last feast was held beneath the swaying sky of the rift. The nine who took turns guarding sat together for the first time in a long while. Doha records a final video, and Seongyeon reflects the swaying route in a cup. "Leaving it open is also a kind of ending," {adviser} says, taking up a brush. The story of the rift ends here.

The last feast was held beneath the sky that became a road. Guests of three ages gathered at the castle site. Doha records a final video, and Seongyeon hung the last lantern at the end of the route. "The road of comings and goings is the name of this castle," {adviser} says, taking up a brush. The story of the rift ends here.
Raise a cup with the nine
The nine and the castle's people raised their cups together — laughter filled the site
The nine called this castle home — lanterns were lit in every alley
Leave the rift's records in the library
The last records were shelved — three ages meet on one bookshelf
📖 Act 7 · The End of the Rift
Showdown on the Great Road · The Plains Castle
The plains castle is ours — rumor has it Gangseo's strike force pulled off the night raid
Ten months passed without taking the plains — only the grain that fed a great army dwindled
On the Red Cliff River · The Riverside Castle
The riverside castle is ours — Seongyeon's record of the wind proved exact that very night
The fight on the river was never won — Seongyeon quietly closed the records
The King of the Rift · The Castle by the Gate
The castle by the rift fell and the gate was pressed shut — Gangseo's strike force roared from the walls
Twelve months passed without taking the castle by the gate — the Rift Soul's power gnawed at the walls
The Source of the Plague · The Castle by the Ruins
The castle by the ruins is ours and the source is sealed — Geumdam's vaccine works reached all the way inside
Twelve months passed without sealing the source — the plague spread to the granaries
The Silk Road Caravan · The Oasis Castle
The oasis castle is ours and a gate stands — an orbital drone found an old city beneath the sand
No castle to guard the road was won — the caravan turned to another way
Ships of the Southern Sea · The Harbor Castle
The harbor castle is ours and the sea route is open — Seongyeon's navigation traced the drift on every island
The harbor stayed out of reach as the seasons turned — the drift went to someone else
Duel round {0} — no winner yet, one more
A freelance debater stands before {neighbour}'s envoy and asks for a debate. Three questions — answer two correctly and win better truce terms.
{adviser} watched as the debate was won and better truce terms were secured
Lost for words, the terms were not won — the envoy left awkwardly
The Debaters' Duel · The Wandering Scholar
Myeongbyeon sat a famed wandering scholar across from him. Three questions — answer two correctly and the scholar joins you of his own will.
The scholar bowed to the debate and stood at your side — the sound of questions grew louder in the academy
The scholar smiled and turned away — yet the sound of debate stayed in the academy
The Oath of the Dead · Duel at the Tomb Gate
Baekgi planted his spear amid the tolling of the graveyard bell. "Whoever wins keeps this night." {champion} steps forward — one move of three each round, until it is decided.
{champion} struck down Baekgi — the bell fell silent and one name was struck from the roll of the dead
{champion} was pushed back — Baekgi withdrew smiling and the bell tolled all night
The Envoy of Daqin · The Interpreters' Debate
Doha's translator carries the envoy's words across. Three questions — answer two correctly and the envoy lowers his terms.
The envoy smiled at the debate and lowered his terms — a new road was drawn on the star map
The words went astray and the envoy was displeased — the translator fell quiet
Yeongjeom planted a spear with his prosthetic arm. "I serve only under one stronger than me." {champion} steps into the yard — one move of three each round, until it is decided.
{champion} struck down Yeongjeom — Yeongjeom lowered his spear and knelt
{champion} was pushed back — Yeongjeom snorted and left for {neighbour}
Not enough gold — we will ask again next month

{adviser} has stood on the wall for a long while, fingering a worn dog tag and telling of an old unit. On the last training day, the faces of those laughing together overlap the faces of this age's soldiers, they say.
Ask them to teach the old unit's drills to this castle's soldiers
{adviser} drilled the soldiers the old unit's way, and their ranks straightened visibly
Hang the dog tag on the castle gate to honor the unit
The tag glittered on the gate and the soldiers straightened their collars
Keep the old unit's story as a record
The story was recorded and a new book joined the library shelf
{adviser} is writing safety rules and pasting them at one side of the wall construction site - a habit from losing a coworker on a job. Behind every line of the rules is somebody's name, they say.
Set up the wall training ground by the rules
Following the rules, soldiers hurt in training dropped visibly
Post the rules all around the castle
With rules posted everywhere, accidents in the alleys fell and hearts settled
Bind the rules into a construction record
The rules record became the library's standard for castle works
{adviser} gazes at a corner of the market for a long time, recalling the day the first shop failed. What was learned that day is all in this castle's ledgers now, they say with a smile.
Appoint shop-minded people to procure military supplies
{adviser} tidied the ledgers, and supplies began arriving on time
Lower stall fees to help small shops
As small shops multiplied, the market bustled with people
Open a new shop on the first shop's spot
The new shop opened and gold began to circulate
{adviser} quietly sorts documents in the courtyard, recalling the first case they lost. It was only after losing that they learned to hold back words.
Set up trials for soldiers' discipline as well
{adviser} set down disciplinary rules, and quarrels in the barracks quietly subsided
Open the courtyard to the people
With the courtyard open, cries of injustice decreased
Bind the pleading records into the library
The pleading records joined the library shelf
{adviser} smiles while turning manuscripts in the library. The first program printed only the word "hello" on the screen, they say - and it is odd how that resembles this age's brush calligraphy.
Extend manuscript organizing to military documents
{adviser} sorted the documents, and mismatched orders became rarer
Open the library to the people for a while
With people coming and going, the sound of reading filled the castle
The story was recorded and a new line appeared in the library
{adviser} gazes at the river from the ferry landing. On the day the first route was drawn, they drew a road that wasn't on the map and got scolded - and laughs that the road turned out right.
Graft the route onto the army's marching roads
{adviser} adjusted the roads and the march became a day faster
Raise lanterns at the ferry landing
With lanterns up at the landing, night river crossings became safe
Leave the first route drawing in the library
The route drawing became a guide for road-seekers in the library
{adviser} looks up at the night sky from the watchtower. On the first day in orbit, looking down, they learned how small and warm the world is - and now they look at this castle with that heart.
Change the watchtower's watch to the orbital way
{adviser} adjusted the watch and the night guard became tighter
Make a stargazing spot on the watchtower
As people gathered at the stargazing spot, the night alleys grew calm
Leave the sky photographs in the library
The sky photographs filled a wall of the library
{adviser} strokes a horse's mane in front of the stable. When they first gripped the control stick their hands trembled, they say. Both horses and sticks follow best when the hand is trusted.
Add piloting knacks to cavalry training
{adviser} taught the knack and the cavalry line's charge grew smooth
With the stable renewed, horses and people felt at ease
Leave the flight trajectories in the library
The trajectory drawings hung in the library and became a sight to see
{adviser} stands in the middle of the martial yard, silently checking a prosthetic. They don't mention that it hurt the day they first wore it - only that this yard resembles an old training ground.
Face the soldiers in person in the martial yard
{adviser} sparred with the soldiers, and the whole yard rang with cheers
Build a resting place in the martial yard
With the resting place built, injured soldiers could rest
Leave the movement records in the library
The movement records joined the library and took the seat beside the martial manuals
